_doc: Foe stat blocks by stable id. names = display per language, aliases = anything a world / roster / hand-off may call it. A world adds or overrides in game/world/world_map.json foes or game/rules/foes.json.

traits.en: hates blood; scatters when half are down
traits.ja: 血を嫌い、半数倒れると散る

traits.zh: 山贼头目,手下散了才肯退
traits.en: the bandit chief; retreats only once his men scatter
traits.ja: 山賊の頭目。手下が散るまで退かない

traits.en: flanks and bites; backs off when hurt
traits.ja: 背後に回って噛む。傷つくと退く

traits.en: slow; hard to kill, never flees
traits.ja: 鈍いが、斬っても倒れず逃げもしない

traits.zh: 以交易与秘密诱惑,不轻易动手
traits.en: tempts with bargains and secrets; slow to strike
traits.ja: 取引と秘密で誘い、簡単には手を出さない

traits.en: comes at night; backs away from fire
traits.ja: 夜に来て、火を見ると退く
